packaging: ImageMagick resize and WebP compression: adaptive 314px image padded to 432px (66dp safe circle), legacy 240px image centered in 192px canvas, TV 240px image on 320x180px background; foreground alpha preserved
original_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished launcher icon foreground for Hypcade, an Android laserdisc arcade emulator. A bold compact front-facing arcade cabinet with a luminous CRT screen containing a single unmistakable geometric uppercase H; a partially visible silver laserdisc tucked behind the cabinet connects it to laserdisc games. Use the project's mint teal (#69DFC0), deep blue-black (#10171D), and restrained silver/white highlights. Tasteful sculpted arcade hardware, crisp silhouette, broad simple shapes, subtle depth, strong contrast, excellent readability at 48 pixels. A small joystick and one large button integrated into the cabinet control panel; no tiny decoration. The H is the only text. One centered isolated mark, transparent background, square canvas; keep the entire mark inside the central 62% of canvas width and height so Android adaptive-icon masks cannot crop it. No background tile, no border, no mockup, no additional words, no watermark, no copyrighted game characters. Deliver a clean finished icon asset.
prompt: Recolor the existing Hypcade cabinet/H/laserdisc mark: golden yellow #F4C542, crimson #8F2028, warm black #160F0D; preserve silver disc, composition and transparency. Dragon’s Lair-inspired palette, no game characters or added text.
